# Yandex Metrika 2.2.0

Practitioner-informed analytics workflow hardening.

- Establish the business objective and distinguish final business conversions from diagnostic micro-events.
- Compare periods only on a compatible metric/dimension/filter/attribution basis.
- Keep zero-conversion rows in denominators and avoid conflating clicks, visits, goal reaches, and transactions.
- Allow PnL/ROAS interpretation only with compatible spend/revenue provenance.
- Keep observation and causal hypothesis separate; correlation alone is not treated as causality.
- Preserve existing quality metadata and exact-preview/write-safety contracts.

Source methodology provenance: `artwist-polyakov/polyakov-claude-skills@f6a75133b3ad07e43991433c1d0a77f69c749f7b`.
